   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  February 9, 2026

Vice Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 5:58 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang,
Commissioner Sanchez, Commissioner Garcia and Commissioner Lopez. Chair Leon was absent. Also
present was Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, Rosalee SantaAna, Senior Management Analyst, and
Laura Zaldivar, Community Information Assistant.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Lopez made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes
for January 12, 2026. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Reorganization of Chair and Vice Chair

Commissioner Sanchez made a motion to nominate Vice Chair Ang as commission chair and
Commissioner Lopez seconded the motion. There being no objection, the motion carried.

Commissioner Garcia made a motion to nominate Commissioner Lopez as commission vice chair and
Chair Ang seconded the motion. There being no objection, the motion carried.

Mrs. Ocegueda informed Chair Ang and Vice Chair Lopez that there is now new training for Chairs and
Vice Chairs to attend; this year’s training is scheduled for Wednesday, March 25, 2026, at 5pm in the
City Council Chambers.

Native Garden Contest

Ms. Ocegueda asked Commissioners to pull a ticket to determine the six (6) winners out of the 16
entries received for the raffle of the native plants provided by Cerritos College. Mrs. Ocegueda stated
that staff is working on logo for the contest and reminded Commissioners their next scheduled
promotional event will be in March at the annual Artastic event.

   Public Comments: Resident Brian Tindell, expressed his thanks to the Commission for moving
  forward with promoting native plants and is looking forward to entering the contest

PastForward Series

Mrs. Ocegueda presented the logo to the Commissioners with the requested changes. Commissioners
reviewed the changes and unanimously voted to keep the original approved logo.

Merchandise

Mrs. Ocegueda stated that staff updated the Keepin’ It Norwalk logo and it now has the city water tower
instead of the Norwalk Town Center sign and confirmed it was already used for the January Keepin’ It
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
February 9, 2026

Norwalk video. Commissioner Sanchez provided a local vendor business card to Mrs. Ocegueda for a
follow-up.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Santa Ana presented the “Keeping It Norwalk” campaign video, January Juice Spots edition, to the
Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda then presented two window cling sticker mock-ups for the
Commission’s review and approval. She explained that the stickers would be provided to contest
winners for display on their doors or windows to further promote the series. The Commissioners
approved both the standard promotional stickers and the window cling designs.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Santa Ana provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda informed the Commissioners that she is currently updating the Holiday Home and
Business Décor Contest. She invited Commissioners to share any ideas or suggestions with her via
email or phone so they may be incorporated into the revised plan. This will allow upcoming meetings
to focus on final review and approval rather than brainstorming, ensuring the contest is ready for
promotion during the summer events. Mrs. Ocegueda also explained to Commissioners that at the
request of City Council the First Responders Luncheon has been rescheduled from October 7, 2026 to
October 28, 2026.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Lopez and Commissioner Sanchez shared their experiences at The Walk Groundbreaking
event. Chair Ang expressed his concerns regarding the parking structure and signage around the
construction area.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 6:49 p.m.

_____________________________

David Ang, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
